description: This file defines several classes related to monitoring aggregation dimensions for Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes base and derived classes for different monitoring contexts such as EventHub, Receiver, Cache, and BlockPool, each encapsulating relevant identifying properties.

classes.name: EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions
classes.description: Base class representing general monitoring aggregation dimensions, primarily holding the EventHub path.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Derived class extending the base to include EventHub partition information for receiver monitoring.

classes.name: EventHubCacheMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Further extension including BlockPoolId for cache monitoring within the EventHub ecosystem.

classes.name: EventHubBlockPoolMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Class representing block pool specific monitoring dimensions, including BlockPoolId.

methods.name: EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions(string ehHubPath)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the base class with the EventHub path.

methods.name: EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions(EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions dimensions)
methods.description: Copy constructor for duplicating an existing dimensions object.

methods.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorDimensions(EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions dimensions, string ehPartition)
methods.description: Constructor initializing receiver dimensions with base dimensions and partition info.

methods.name: EventHubCacheMonitorDimensions(EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions dimensions, string ehPartition, string blockPoolId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache dimensions with base, partition, and block pool ID.

methods.name: EventHubBlockPoolMonitorDimensions(EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions dimensions, string blockPoolId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing block pool dimensions with base and block pool ID.
